desc:
Kat Infection is a team based game where there are Infecteds (also known as Nekos) and Humans.
(credits to nicopatty for the music and shop inspiration)

You can buy weapons in the shop to fight against eachother or emotes to chill and hangout with other players.

Controls :
M1 - Use/Attack
F - Parry
R - Finisher

C - Crouch
Shift - Sprint
Shift + C - Slide
Shift + C (While in the air) - Dropkick
R - Finisher

/katinfection
